{{Quote|She is telling the truth, Dmaynel. That is what I sensed.|Mnor Nha on Gavin Darklighter|<ref name="WG" />}}
'''Mnor Nha''' was a [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] who lived in the [[Alien Protection Zone/Legends|Invisec]] area of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Biography==
Mnor Nha joined the [[Alien Combine]], an anti-Imperial, anti-[[Human/Legends|Human]] band of [[Alien Protection Zone/Legends|Invisec]] dwellers on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends]]. They carried out attacks against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and, quick to judge Humans as bigoted, [[Death/Legends|killed]] those they felt to be so and sent their bodies back as warnings to the Empire.<ref name="WG" />

Mnor was instrumental in such attacks due to his empathic skills as a [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]], being able to sense the feelings of their targets to determine if they harbor any anti-alien sentiments. One such potential victim was [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Gavin Darklighter]], but when Darklighter and his Rogue companions were brought before [[Dmaynel Kiph]], the leader of the Alien Combine, the Empire raided their headquarters. Nha's fate after the attack is not known.<ref name="WG" />
